title: Lateral Controller Stanley
text: Control steering angle of vehicle for path following by using Stanley method, 7 inputs, 1 output; {Vehicle model}, {Position gain of forward motion} sets the position gain of vehicle in forward motion, {Position gain of reverse motion} sets the position gain of vehicle in reverse motion, {Yaw rate feedback gain}, {Steering angle feedback gain}, {Wheelbase of vehicle (m)} sets the distance between front and rear axle, {Vehicle mass (kg)}, {Longitudinal distance from center of mass to front axle (m)} sets the distance to front axle, {Longitudinal distance from center of mass to rear axle (m)} sets the distance to rear axle, {Front tire corner stiffness (N/rad)} sets the cornering stiffness of front tires and {Maximum steering angle (deg)} sets the maximum allowed steering angle. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: RefPose
ports.summary: Reference pose [ x, y, Θ ] vector

ports.name: CurrPose
ports.summary: Current pose [ x, y, Θ ] vector
